# Local verification plan

<!-- Generated by tools/checks/checks.py plan from tests/local/checks.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

## When you are back at the PC

1. Close GTA IV. In PowerShell at the repository root: `git checkout develop` and `git pull`.
2. First time only: `./tools/verify-local.ps1 -Smoke -GameDirectory '<GTAIV folder>'` (about 10 minutes; proves the script itself works, then restores your install).
3. Then the full run: `./tools/verify-local.ps1` (it remembers the game folder). It builds, installs, runs every automated check, and asks you about each manual check. You can skip any.
4. It pushes the results to the `verification-results` branch. Start a cloud session with: *Process the newest verification results.*
5. Nothing else to do: the cloud session fixes failures and queues new checks.

## What is queued

| Kind | Pending | Runs |
|---|---|---|
| pc-offline | 8 | automatically (builds and tests that need Windows or the game's files) |
| probe | 2 | automatically (read-only questions about the game's files; structure only) |
| scenario | 17 | automatically (autopilot drives the game; about 2-4 minutes each) |
| manual | 17 | you play and judge; about 160 minutes in total, grouped below |

Statuses: QUEUED (never run on the current code), PASS, FAIL, ERROR, CRASH, NOT-RUN, NEEDS-REVIEW (a person or the review session must judge screenshots or log errors).

## Manual checks, grouped into play sessions

Do the sessions in order; stop whenever you like. Each check links to its full steps. Answer p (pass), f (fail) or s (skip) when the script asks, and add a note for anything odd.

### Session 1: gunplay and feel (about 55 minutes)

Load a free-roam save, go to the test range (DevTools > TELEPORT). Keep DevTools (L3+R3 or F10) handy.

**Phase 1 gunplay checklist** `T010-phase1` (T-010, 15 min)

1. Follow docs/testing/PHASE1_PLAYTEST.md sections 1-10 (startup, DevTools, test range, free aim, gold weapons, movement/cover/vehicle, live tuning, save/load).
2. Skip anything you have already confirmed on an earlier build unless it looks different now.

- Pass when: every section behaves as the checklist describes; note any section that does not
- Full steps: [docs/testing/PHASE1_PLAYTEST.md](../../docs/testing/PHASE1_PLAYTEST.md)

**Gold carbine and shotgun finishes** `T011-gold-finishes` (T-011, 4 min)

1. DevTools (L3+R3 or F10) > WEAPONS: give the gold carbine (59) and the gold shotgun (60).
2. Look at each held gun and its HUD icon; reload, aim and fire.

- Pass when: both guns and icons are gold with normal-map detail, and stay gold after reload/aim/fire
- Full steps: [docs/tasks/T-011-gold-finishes.md#human-test-steps](../../docs/tasks/T-011-gold-finishes.md#human-test-steps)

**Debug overlay hit info** `T013-debug-hit-info` (T-013, 4 min)

1. DevTools > GUNPLAY > Debug overlay ON.
2. At the test range shoot a ped, then a vehicle, then a wall.

- Pass when: the Hit line shows ped with a bone number, distance and damage, then vehicle, then world/unknown; fire shows interval and RPM
- Full steps: [docs/tasks/T-013-debug-hit-info.md#human-test-steps](../../docs/tasks/T-013-debug-hit-info.md#human-test-steps)

**Aim profiles (free / vanilla / rejected slowdown)** `T014-aim-profiles` (T-014, 6 min)

1. Follow the three steps in the task card (edit freeAim.profile in the installed gunplay.json, then DevTools > PRESETS & CONFIG > Reload config from disk).

- Pass when: free: no snap or lock; vanilla: your own Auto-Aim applies; slowdown: rejected, previous profile kept
- Full steps: [docs/tasks/T-014-aim-profiles.md#human-test-steps](../../docs/tasks/T-014-aim-profiles.md#human-test-steps)

**Shoulder swap** `T015-shoulder-swap` (T-015, 5 min)

1. Aim on foot (L2/LT) and press L1/LB (or Z): the camera moves to the left shoulder; press again for the right.
2. Try it in cover and from a vehicle.

- Pass when: smooth swap in about 0.2 s, aim and crosshair stay centred, nothing odd in cover or vehicles
- Full steps: [docs/tasks/T-015-shoulder-swap.md#human-test-steps](../../docs/tasks/T-015-shoulder-swap.md#human-test-steps)

**Switch weapons while aiming** `T016-switch-while-aiming` (T-016, 4 min)

1. Carry two Arsenal weapons. Hold L2/LT and press D-pad right, then left.
2. Repeat crouched and out of cover; with one weapon nothing should cycle; in a vehicle it is off.

- Pass when: the held weapon cycles only among carried items while aiming, without camera drop
- Full steps: [docs/tasks/T-016-switch-while-aiming.md#human-test-steps](../../docs/tasks/T-016-switch-while-aiming.md#human-test-steps)

**Per-shot shake and aim FOV** `T017-feel-shake-fov` (T-017, 4 min)

1. Aim and fire the gold pistol, carbine and shotgun; then their vanilla counterparts.

- Pass when: gold weapons: subtle per-shot shake and slightly narrower aim FOV; vanilla weapons: no change
- Full steps: [docs/tasks/T-017-feel-shake-fov.md#human-test-steps](../../docs/tasks/T-017-feel-shake-fov.md#human-test-steps)

**Phase 2 gun feel: taps, bursts, spray** `T024-gun-feel` (T-024, 5 min)

1. At the range fire single shots, three-round bursts and one long carbine spray at the same distance, with gold 58/59/60.
2. Compare impacts with the crosshair gap; repeat moving, crouched, in cover and from a vehicle.

- Pass when: tight taps, useful bursts, visibly broader long spray; impacts stay inside the displayed cone
- Full steps: [docs/tasks/T-024-phase2-foundations.md#human-test-steps](../../docs/tasks/T-024-phase2-foundations.md#human-test-steps)

**Visible holsters** `T021-holsters` (T-021, 8 min)

1. Task card steps 1-6: back/hip/thigh positions, vehicles and bikes, the Holsters page, death and ReloadScripts.

- Pass when: props sit where described, follow the body, hide in cars, and never duplicate after reload
- Full steps: [docs/tasks/T-021-holsters.md#human-test-steps](../../docs/tasks/T-021-holsters.md#human-test-steps)

## What each check proves, and what stays unproven

- `LOOP-build`: The Windows toolchain builds the same sources the cloud built; the native unit tests pass on the game's target (i686 Windows).
- `LOOP-verify`: Every verifier section, including the 7 the cloud reports NOT-RUN: address resolution against GTAIV.exe, native names and CE hashes, the core native table, vehicle extras, gore particles in gta_core.wpfl, WeaponInfo.xml accuracies and the collapse engine's x86 hook code.
- `LOOP-content-selftest`: The content compiler behaves the same on .NET Framework as under Mono in the cloud (codecs, writer, validator).
- `T028-wtdcheck`: The from-scratch WTD writer reproduces Rockstar's dictionaries byte for byte apart from placement. **Still unproven:** That the game loads and draws a native dictionary (T028-native-texture-review).
- `LOOP-blender-tests`: The 9 build expectations the cloud reports NOT-RUN: template and native builds from Blender, LOD counts, previews, modifiers, collection export.
- `LOOP-package-install`: The develop build packages against the owner's game (content assets compiled on game templates) and installs cleanly. Every scenario check depends on it.
- `T028-native-crate-report`: The native writer's output for a real asset built against the game's template passes read-back.
- `T028-alpha-panel-report`: DXT5 with alpha is written and read back for a real asset.
- `PROBE-drawables`: Across the game's model archives: how many drawables use several geometries, several shaders and LOD slots 1-3, how their buffers, shader mappings, bounds and LOD distances are laid out, and whether the reader parses them all. Input for the multi-geometry/LOD writer (Session 4). **Still unproven:** Anything about how the game renders them; this is file structure only.
- `PROBE-collision`: Which collision-related resources the game ships (by extension and resource type), in which archives, how many, their resource versions and top-level sizes. Input for collision research (Session 5). **Still unproven:** The bound structures' field meanings; those need their own probes once the inventory is known.
- `T027-raycast`: SDK 1.1 Query.Raycast / HasLineOfSight against world, a vehicle and a ped through the real game line test; filtering and ignore semantics; no faults. **Still unproven:** Objects (props with collision) are not tested in game yet (RayMask.Objects); research questions R1-R6 in docs/research/Raycast.md.
- `T027-raycast-spike`: Raw line-test results per include bit for ground, sky, a vehicle and a ped: evidence for Raycast.md open questions. **Still unproven:** Research only; interpretation happens in the review session.
- `SDK-selftest`: Every Liberty.Sdk service works in game on the new core ABI 5, including the ten raycast/line-of-sight checks.
- `T028-native-texture-review`: The game loads dictionaries written from scratch and draws DXT1; how gta_default treats DXT5 alpha. **Still unproven:** Alpha behaviour is an observation (translucent, cut-out or ignored); any of the three is a valid answer.
- `SDK-asset-review`: The template-mode content pipeline still produces textured, upright, lit props after the T-028 merge.
- `SDK-engine-events`: Core v2 snapshot events still fire on the new core ABI.
- `SDK-bullet-events`: The bullet trace list still produces BulletFired events.
- `SDK-exact-damage`: The damage-response hook still reports attacker, weapon, type, bone and hit point, and the kill.
- `SDK-vehicle-events`: VehicleAppeared/VehicleRemoved still fire.
- `SDK-hot-reload`: Module restart and mod assembly reload still work; the SDK self-test passes on reloaded code.
- `SDK-inspector-review`: The inspector overlay still draws engine numbers and module rows.
- `SDK-ui-review`: SDK list and radial menus still draw and release input.
- `T022-gore-review`: Arm, leg and head severing still work under the engine. **Still unproven:** Presentation quality (stump caps) is the owner's judgement in T022-combat-effects.
- `T021-sling-review`: Both slings and the slung long guns attach and follow the body.
- `T024-trunk-review`: The trunk sequence and the storage radial menu work on the engine.
- `T026-perf-baseline`: Per-frame script cost on the develop build, comparable with earlier samples.
- `T026-perf-stress`: Script cost and the density governor under load.
- `T007-confirm-done`: Lets the owner mark T-007 DONE.
- `T010-phase1`: Phase 1 integrated gunplay on the develop build.
- `T011-gold-finishes`: The gold finishes render.
- `T013-debug-hit-info`: The debug overlay's hit reporting.
- `T014-aim-profiles`: Aim profile switching and rejection.
- `T015-shoulder-swap`: Shoulder swap on the CE camera.
- `T016-switch-while-aiming`: Weapon cycling while aiming.
- `T017-feel-shake-fov`: Feel effects are gated to the test weapons.
- `T024-gun-feel`: Phase 2 spread and recoil tuning.
- `T020-storage-basics`: Liberty Arsenal core storage and ownership.
- `T024-storage-prompt`: Phase 2 storage interaction.
- `T025-gunsmith`: Weapon instances, gunsmith purchases and attachments.
- `T020-death-mission-persistence`: Arsenal's mission, death, arrest and persistence rules.
- `T021-holsters`: Holster placement and lifecycle.
- `T022-combat-effects`: Combat effects and dismemberment on ambient peds. **Still unproven:** Stump cap geometry remains an open item.
- `T023-lvs-labels`: The T-023 labels on real vehicles.
- `T026-performance-feel`: The owner's perception of frame pacing on the develop build (the perf scenarios measure script cost).
